description: Hand-authored switching example: single-phase 480 V RMS / 60 Hz, 24 V at 1 A into 24 Ω. Diode bridge, 100 µF bulk, ideal 8:1 transformer plus 2 mH magnetizing inductance, Boolean-controlled primary switch, 50 kHz PWM generator, 50 ms soft start after 30 ms of bus precharge, sampled PI regulation. Finite diode and switch resistances and off conductances regularize commutation. Separate primary/secondary references; ideal magnetic coupling. Omits leakage inductance, core saturation/loss, device capacitances, clamp/snubber, EMI filter and practical isolation/control circuitry. Simulation example, not a hardware design.

annotations.detail: Soft start, sampled PI, 0–18 % duty. Exports to C.
480 V RMS to 24 V at 1 A through an 8:1 flyback.
